
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/gpustack/p/21721810" title="发布于 2026-07-21 11:26">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Day 0 实测｜在 GPUStack 上部署 Inkling-BF16：8 卡 H20-141G 推理性能测试</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Inkling 是由 Thinking Machines Lab 发布的新一代开源多模态大语言模型，采用 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）Transformer 架构，支持文本、图像和音频等多模态输入，并生成文本输出。模型拥有约 975B 总参数、41B 激活参数，并支持最长 1M token 上下文窗口。</p>
<p>在能力方面，Inkling 面向通用智能、Agent、工具调用以及复杂推理任务进行了优化，同时支持 MTP（Multi-Token Prediction）等推理加速技术，可结合 vLLM、SGLang 等主流推理引擎进行部署。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/ca70a4f2f0600fa75f8a6fb57a0e2265.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="1-登录-gpustack-选择推理后端">1. 登录 GPUStack 选择推理后端</h2>
<p>测试环境：</p>
<ul>
<li>8 × H20-141G</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="2-添加版本">2. 添加版本</h2>
<p>点击 <strong>添加版本（Add Version）</strong></p>
<p>镜像名称：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">vllm/vllm-openai:nightly
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="Add vLLM Version" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720141811.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="3-点击部署开始部署">3. 点击部署，开始部署</h2>
<h3 id="node-0-参数">Node 0 参数</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">--trust-remote-code
--tokenizer-mode=inkling
--kernel-config.enable_flashinfer_autotune=False
--tensor-parallel-size=8
--data-parallel-size=2
--data-parallel-size-local=1
--enable-expert-parallel
--data-parallel-rpc-port=13389
--data-parallel-address=10.91.3.213
--data-parallel-hybrid-lb
--max-model-len=131072
--max-num-seqs=10
--enable-auto-tool-choice
--tool-call-parser=inkling
--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'
--reasoning-parser=inkling
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="Node 0 参数配置" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720142047.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>环境变量：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">PYPI_PACKAGES_INSTALL=scipy==1.18.0 -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<h3 id="node-1-参数">Node 1 参数</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">--trust-remote-code
--tokenizer-mode=inkling
--kernel-config.enable_flashinfer_autotune=False
--tensor-parallel-size=8
--data-parallel-size=2
--data-parallel-size-local=1
--data-parallel-start-rank 1
--enable-expert-parallel
--data-parallel-rpc-port=13389
--data-parallel-address=10.91.3.213
--data-parallel-hybrid-lb
--max-model-len=131072
--max-num-seqs=10
--enable-auto-tool-choice
--tool-call-parser=inkling
--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'
--reasoning-parser=inkling
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="Node 1 参数配置" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720142207.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>环境变量：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">PYPI_PACKAGES_INSTALL=scipy==1.18.0 -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<p>模型进入 Running 状态后，可以直接通过 GPUStack 试验场进行交互测试。</p>
<p>在默认配置下，Inkling 输出速度达到 <strong>80+ Tokens/s</strong>，能够正常完成多轮文本对话，并支持思考过程解析。</p>
<p><img alt="运行结果" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720143409.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>同时支持原生多模态能力。</p>
<p><img alt="原生多模态支持" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720143542.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="4-测评">4. 测评</h2>
<p>测试配置：</p>
<ul>
<li>Input Length：64K</li>
<li>Output Length：3K</li>
<li>Requests：10</li>
</ul>
<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img alt="测试结果" loading="lazy" data-src="https://gpustack-cn-blogs.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/assets/huadan/inkling/Pasted%20image%2020260720150624.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>指标</th>
<th>结果</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Output Token Throughput</td>
<td>56.10 tok/s</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Peak Output Throughput</td>
<td>78.00 tok/s</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Total Token Throughput</td>
<td>1253.09 tok/s</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Mean TTFT</td>
<td>92.77s</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Mean TPOT</td>
<td>97.09 ms/token</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>在长上下文输入场景下，Inkling 可以稳定完成 64K 上下文推理任务，并保持持续输出能力。</p>
